in_sanskrit.name: Jonu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Born from the water
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jonu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jonu is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jal' meaning water and 'Nu' meaning born. It signifies a person who is born from the water or is associated with water in some way.
